QuestInfo.name: Following the Bowman
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce's story leave you much to ponder. Who's Tess and where might you find him? Head back to the Six Path Crossway. That hasn't failed you yet!
QuestInfo.1: You found the guy Athena Pierce was talking about at the Six Path Crossway. He's heading for the Nautilus. Follow him!
QuestInfo.2: You follow Tess, the strange pirate, that Athena Pierce talked about and find him fighting a weird rabbit.

1.0: Don't just stand there! Help me! \r\nWait a second. Is that you, #bKao#k?!
